name: HOOAH SMA 2015

venue.name: [San Marcos Academy](http://www.smba.org/)
venue.details: Follow the entrance until you reach the gymnasium. More details on competition website.

information: Registration will be $15 and will cover the 3x3 event. Any other event will be an additional dollar. San Marcos Academy Students will have a discounted rate of $10 dollars for the base price, and chlidren of or any active duty and retired service members will be able to compete for free.  $1 will go to the WCA.
